verdict.rationale: Docs mention diff inspection before merge (cursor-docs-4) and support for running multiple agent sessions in parallel via worktrees and subagents (cursor-supp-worktrees, cursor-supp-subagents, cursor-docs-8), which together imply the desktop app can host concurrent, isolated sessions. However, none of the evidence describes the actual visual diff-review UI or a literal side-by-side session view, and all evidence is vendor-documented with no independent/hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: concrete UI screenshots/description of the diff viewer, explicit 'side-by-side sessions' UI documentation, and independent corroboration of the desktop experience.
